description: The catalogue's own orbit mark, alive: the header logo (three orbit ellipses, nucleus, electron) drawn on canvas with a flow field around it -- hundreds of luminous streams ride a noise field and, when they pass near an orbit, get captured into it and circle the nucleus like electrons before drifting off again; the nucleus glows as a sink and a real electron runs the first orbit. Optional eyebrow/title/body copy sits beside the mark behind a readability veil, so it works as a brand hero or a cover slide. Pointer bends the field. Honours prefers-reduced-motion (one pre-simulated frame), pauses offscreen, DPR-aware. Dark backgrounds only. Same kit and hardening as flow_field: every option is an enum or a clamped int, colours must be #rrggbb.
